exceptions.name: @fontsource/jura

obligations.verification: The Jura woff2/woff files are bundled into dist/_astro and the unmodified license text ships at public/licenses/jura-OFL-1.1.txt. Reassess if the font is modified or renamed (OFL reserved-name and no-sale-alone terms).

exceptions.rationale: Jura is the brand typeface for the lowercase groovemap wordmark and headings, self-hosted from the pinned @fontsource/jura package. OFL-1.1 permits bundling and redistribution of the unmodified font with the copyright notice and license; it is a font license, not a code license, and is allowed only for this package and version.
exceptions.role: Self-hosted brand typeface (Jura 300/400/500, latin subset) shipped in the Pages artifact.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64

obligations.verification: The license gate fails if dist contains libvips, a dynamic library, or a native Node module. Reassess notice/source-offer obligations before any workflow begins distributing the build tool or native library.

exceptions.rationale: The locked dependency is present in the local build environment through Astro 7.2.8 -> Sharp 0.35.5. This site uses ordinary public SVG references rather than Astro image processing, and the static dist artifact contains no libvips library, Sharp binary, native module, or derivative. The exception is package- and version-specific; LGPL is not generally allowed.
exceptions.role: Platform-specific optional libvips binary used transitively by Astro's optional Sharp build/image toolchain on Apple silicon.
